summary: Monster Truck Racing Game 3 for toddlers & young kids! Start your trucks engines
description:
Monster Trucks racing game for young kids and toddlers! this is the 3rd installment of this popular kids monster truck game! If your kids love monster trucks than this game is for them!

The game is designed for young Children and toddlers between ages 2 to 10 years old, with very simple controls to accelerate and brake so they can drive the toy monster trucks throughout the house locations. 
To make the game more easier for children to play, the truck never flips ensuring your child always gets to the finish line, and the AI opponent trucks slow down when they are ahead, to give your child the best chance of winning each race!

Fun colorful buttons to Jump, Beep the horn and change the music track or activate the nitro to speed up ahead of the other cars. Unlock new antenas and wheels to blaze up your monster truck.

Crush the cars along the race tracks with the toy monster machines, with fireworks and balloon popping are at the end of each level to give more excitement to the kids playing.

Want to take a break and get some learning in? try one of the mini games included
* Jigsaw Puzzles
* Memory Cards
* Balloon Pop
* Claw Machine

With over 40 monster trucks to choose from and more always being added and over 50 Levels accross 24 different locations to blaze across, gives your child countless hours of fun!

Monster Trucks Kids Game helps your child understand the educational mechanics of using mobile and tablet devices. with puzzles, memory card and heaps of fun racing action.

Features:
* TONS of Monster Trucks to choose from with more always being added
* 50 Levels to play, Race in the Kids Room, The Bathroom, The Backyard, and many more places.
* Fun 3D HD cartoon graphics
* 5 fun kids music sound tracks for the child to choose.
* Cute Monster trucks, engines, horns + much more vibrant sounds 
* Balloon pop game & Fireworks at the end of each race.
* Mini Games such as Puzzles, Claw Machine, Memory Cards & Balloon Pop
+ much more.

Privacy Information:
As parents ourselves, Raz Games takes children's privacy and protection very seriously. We do not collect any personal data.  This app does contain advertising as that allows us to give you the game for free – ads are carefully placed so kids are least likely to accidentally click on them. and ads get removed on the actual game screen. This app includes the option for adults to unlock or buy additional in-game items with real money to enhance game play and removing ads. You may disable in-app purchases by adjusting your device settings.
